records.title: AI-BASED SUSTAINABLE MINING
details:
Air Quality Monitoring System (CAAQMS) and Continuous Effluent Quality Monitoring
Stations (CEQMS) are being introduced for real-time air and water quality monitoring
in 111 mines.
